description: This source file implements credential handling functionalities for a version control system, including initialization, clearing secrets, matching credentials, reading from and writing to storage, and interacting with credential helpers.

methods.name: void credential_init(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure with default values.

methods.name: void credential_clear(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears sensitive information and resets the credential.

methods.name: void credential_next_state(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Advances the credential's state headers.

methods.name: void credential_clear_secrets(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears secret fields like password and credential.

methods.name: void credential_set_capability(struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Sets a specific capability flag for credential operations.

methods.name: void credential_set_all_capabilities(struct credential * c,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for a credential.

methods.name: void credential_announce_capabilities(struct credential * c,FILE * fp)
methods.description: Announces available capabilities over a credential.

methods.name: int credential_match(const struct credential * want,const struct credential * have,int match_password)
methods.description: Checks if two credentials match based on specified fields.

methods.description: Handles configuration callback for credential options.

methods.name: void credential_describe(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Provides a description of the credential as a URL string.

methods.name: void credential_format(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Formats credential into a URL string representation.

methods.name: char * credential_ask_one(const char * what,struct credential * c,int flags)
methods.description: Prompts user for a credential component (e.g., username, password).

methods.name: int credential_getpass(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Retrieves password input from the user if necessary.

methods.description: Checks if a credential has a specific capability.

methods.name: void credential_fill(struct repository * r,struct credential * c,int all_capabilities)
methods.description: fills missing credential info by calling helpers or user input.

methods.name: void credential_approve(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Marks credentials as approved and stores them.

methods.name: void credential_reject(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Rejects and clears credentials, optionally erasing stored credentials.
